steps.en: Vehicle and Notice search tabs work without logging in
steps.id: Tab pencarian Vehicle dan Notice bisa dipakai tanpa login

steps.en: Search by foreign passport ID without Singpass
steps.id: Cari denda lewat ID paspor asing tanpa Singpass
steps.why_en: The ID tab only offers Singpass or Corppass login; there is no passport search.
steps.why_id: Tab ID hanya menawarkan login Singpass atau Corppass; tidak ada pencarian paspor.

steps.en: Search fines by payment reference number
steps.id: Cari denda lewat nomor payment reference
steps.why_en: Only notice numbers are accepted; payment reference numbers have no search path.
steps.why_id: Hanya nomor notice yang diterima; nomor payment reference tidak punya jalur pencarian.

steps.en: Outstanding fines are shown after a search without login
steps.id: Denda outstanding tampil setelah pencarian tanpa login
